entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to yourself.
entries.officialDescription: Applies The Western Covenant, increasing your outgoing physical damage, STR, and END by 50%, and DoT Resistance by 80%. If you are in Defensive Stance, applies Castellan Doctrine, further increasing your END by 50%. If you are in Offensive Stance, applies Venator Doctrine, increasing your Crit Chance and Physical Resistance by 35%. Effects last for 15 seconds. Both Doctrines consume each other.

entries.target: A long range attack that deals damage to 1 target.
entries.officialDescription: You perform a single strike for massive damage based on the number of The Watch Eternal stacks on the target while consuming those stacks and applying Austerity, healing you after 1 second. notes: The two stacks of The Watch Eternal are applied after the skill does damage.
